rubric_items.reason: All 15 ACs (S-1 AC1-5, S-2 AC1-4, S-3 AC1, S-4 AC1, S-5 AC1-4) have at least one TP test, and REQ-1 to REQ-13 are all traced. No test claims an AC that does not exist.
API behaviour is tested at integration level with Supertest and a real DB. Page rendering is tested at unit level with jsdom and a mocked API client. There are no e2e or manual tests.

TP-16 covers the invalid filter and TP-17 the zone fallback. TP-6/7/8 cover the status exclusions and TP-18 the null display. The new TP-19 covers the boundary at exactly now and past appointments, which resolves the earlier F-1.

Uses the strategy's tools (Vitest, Supertest, PostgreSQL with a fixed clock, jsdom, Testing Library). Titles now start with the requirement ID, and the new web test goes in web/src/__tests__, matching the layout.
Each title is short and runnable and gives its level and AC. TP-19 states exactly what it expects. Known, Assumed and Unknown each say what they rest on.
